newsitem.title: INDIA: India metals mixed as trade awaits new sale prices.
newsitem.headline: India metals mixed as trade awaits new sale prices.

text.p: Indian metals' prices on Wednesday were mixed as the trade awaited the announcement of selling prices by state-owned agencies for the second half of this month, dealers said.
Nickel and zinc fell while other base metals were steady.

Nickel prices dropped by 100 rupees at 36,700 rupees per quintal on demand resistance at higher levels while a setback in the world market prompted profit-taking. Nickel was up by 200 rupees per quintal on Tuesday.
Zinc slid by 50 rupees at 7,850 rupees per quintal on improved arrivals after a gain of 50 rupees on Tuesday.
Copper was quoted steady at 13,550 rupees per quintal, aluminium at 7,525 rupees and lead at 4,150 rupees per quintal.
Tin was available at a previous level of 31,100 rupees per quintal but industrial buying remained slow.
